title: Extended States with Extensive Disorder
exact_target: Establish, in some energy range, the existence of extended eigenstates or continuous spectrum for linear operators with extensive disorder, such as a discrete Schrödinger operator with an i.i.d. random potential acting on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}^d)$. Also clarify the borderline case $d=2$.
